name: shuffle_playlist
description: Creates a shuffled copy of any Volumio playlist, named '<playlist> shuffle'.
author: karkolom223

volumio_info.details: Turn your library into a personal radio: put the folders you want into one playlist (audiobooks and podcasts simply stay out), then create a shuffled clone with 'shuffle' added to its name. Every track plays once per pass and the Previous button works normally. Recommended together with an autostart plugin that remembers and resumes the queue, so tracks do not repeat after a restart.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.0.2 - use Volumio core modules (kew, v-conf); 1.0.1 - fix package layout, settings button, translations; 1.0.0 - first release
